spec.timeout_scope: Whole Node CLI-matrix run including fixture/reset, warmup, timed commands and correctness queries. Each individual CLI invocation has a separate 120000ms bound; neither timeout is a completed latency.
spec.memory_scope: Node CLI-matrix driver only; this memory metric excludes coflow.exe descendants and must not be reported as CLI memory. Use measure-cli-memory.mjs for direct CLI measurements.

memory_limitations: OS cumulative PeakWorkingSet64 is observed at startup, approximately every 100ms, and best-effort after exit. The last interval can be missed; no successful observations produce null, not zero. Descendant processes are excluded.
